name: Double Minded
overview: Scripture warns against being double minded, describing such a person as unstable in all their ways (James 1:8) and likening their wavering faith to a wave tossed by the wind (James 1:6). The Bible teaches that one cannot serve two masters, emphasizing the necessity of single-hearted devotion to God rather than divided loyalties (Matthew 6:24). True faith is demonstrated by being doers of the Word, not merely hearers, to avoid self-deception (James 1:22), and believers are encouraged to firmly embrace mercy and truth, writing them upon their hearts (Proverbs 3:3).
